top_signals.title: PHP shares mitigation for new RCE vulnerability with no patch
top_signals.summary: The PHP security team has shared mitigation measures for a new remote code execution vulnerability that affects systems with non-default configurations and has no patch. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: TikTok U.S. hunts for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity, sources tell CNBC
top_signals.summary: The operator of the social media platform in the U.S. has sounded out opportunities to obtain capacity over the coming years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Singapore Expands Haze Investigation to 10 Locally Based Firms
top_signals.summary: Singapore expanded its investigation into haze-creating fires in Indonesia that have blanketed the city-state in smog, requesting information from 10 locally registered companies.
